title: RLinf run control-plane snapshot
description: Contract for <log_path>/_rlinf/runs/<run_id>/run.json. The training side writes it (plain stdlib, atomic replace); the dashboard reads it without importing rlinf. This file is the single source of truth for both sides -- each keeps its own model (dataclass / pydantic) and validates against this schema.

schema_version.description: Bumped from 1 to 2 to add the three-timestamp liveness model, concurrent components, structured resume fields, and step semantics. See feature_list.md section 2.7.

run_id.description: Unique per launch, injected as cfg.runner.run_id. Format <timestamp>-<experiment_name>.

task_type.description: Mirrors SUPPORTED_TASK_TYPE in rlinf/config.py. Also the dashboard template selection key.

algorithm.description: Optional secondary template key when task_type alone is too coarse.

state.description: Write-side fact only. Deliberately has no 'stalled': a dead writer cannot record its own death, so liveness is derived read-side from the timestamps below (see 'health' in the dashboard, which is NOT persisted here).

phase.description: Driver-side phase, narrowed in v2 to the innermost non-'step' ScopedTimer scope. For async runners a single scalar phase cannot describe env/rollout/actor running concurrently -- use 'components' for that. Unmapped scopes pass through verbatim.

components.description: Concurrent component activity for async runners, where env/rollout/actor may run for the whole loop. Empty or null for synchronous runners.

heartbeat_at.description: Updated by the background heartbeat thread. Proves the process is alive -- nothing more.

heartbeat_seq.description: Monotonic tick counter; lets a reader distinguish a fresh write from an unchanged file.

last_progress_at.description: Updated on step advance. A fresh heartbeat with stale progress indicates a hung training thread, such as an NCCL hang or stuck environment.

last_metric_at.description: Updated from the MetricLogger.log callback. Detects a broken metric path while training still advances.

epoch.description: Only when the runner already tracks it; never synthesized.

step_semantics.description: What one step means for this runner, so readers can label the x-axis and avoid comparing incompatible runs. Embodied and SFT runs report rl_iteration; reasoning and coding runs report minibatch. This labels existing behavior without changing step accounting.

latest_checkpoint.description: Mirror of the last line of checkpoints.jsonl. Appended only after _save_checkpoint completes, so readers do not observe a half-written checkpoint.

paths.description: Where the data plane lives: tensorboard dir, per-worker log root, video root.

allOf.description: A terminal failure must say why.
A live run must not carry exit info.
